resources.string: Play a video, then pinch to zoom and drag to reframe. Record captures your camera movement and exports a new video.
Rotating the video also turns the exported video. Recorded camera moves are cleared when you rotate.
Slows or speeds up the preview only. Camera moves are saved against the video\'s own time; the exported video keeps its original speed.
Press REC, then pinch to zoom and drag to move. Press STOP when you are done.
Record a camera move before exporting.
Not enough free storage. Free some space and try again.
The video cannot be read (moved, deleted, or access was lost). Pick it again.
This phone cannot decode or encode this video format. Try another clip.
